sources.title: See3CAM_24CUG - AR0234CS Full HD Color Global Shutter Camera (e-con Systems product page)
sources.covers: sensor, shutter, pixel size, optical format, FOV with e-con's lens, focus, interface, power (max/min), mass, size

sources.title: See3CAM_24CUG Datasheet, Revision 1.5, 06 November 2023 (e-con Systems; copy hosted by Arrow Electronics)
sources.covers: stream modes and frame rates per format and USB speed (Table 2), crop in FOV, power per mode (Tables 8-12), size, variants

note: The entry is the board camera with e-con's M12 lens and no enclosure (See3CAM_24CUG_CHL_TC); the enclosure variant (See3CAM_24CUG_CHL_TC_BX) is 35.3 x 35.3 x 29 mm and 57 g with lens. The FOV 104.6 (H) x 61.6 (V) x 128.2 (D) degrees is stated "with the lens provided by e-con" and, per the datasheet, "for the maximum resolution" (1920 x 1200). The datasheet's crop table gives 1920 x 1080 and 1280 x 720 as 0 % horizontal and 10 % vertical crops of the full image (1280 x 720 is therefore also scaled), which is what the library's centred-crop rule assumes. The lens model is pinhole, a labelled assumption: the maker states no projection or distortion, and the stated horizontal, vertical and diagonal angles do not fit one distortion-free pinhole with square pixels (a wide lens with barrel distortion), so a pinhole fitted to the horizontal and vertical angles has non-square pixels and misplaces the corners; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. Not stated: f-number, lens focal length, distortion. Stream modes are the USB 3.2 Gen 1 column of Table 2 (USB 2.0 gives fewer fps). bits_per_pixel 16 for UYVY is the format's definition (4:2:2), not a datasheet figure; MJPEG is compressed (null). power_w is the maximum the page states (2.02 W, 1920 x 1200 MJPEG at 114 fps on USB 3.2 Gen 1, Table 8). The page says "USB 3.1 Gen 1", the datasheet "USB 3.2 Gen 1": the same 5 Gbit/s signalling (USB-IF). size_mm is the stated l x b x h without lens, 30 x 30 x 26 mm, entered as [26, 30, 30] on the reading that h is along the optical axis (an assumption: the page does not say which axis is which).

imagers.name: Colour
imagers.figures_conflict: The stated diagonal (128.2 deg) is wider than a centred, radially symmetric lens without pincushion distortion can show with the stated 104.6 x 61.6 deg across 1920 x 1200 px (at most about 116 deg): the three angles were probably not measured on the same image. The library uses the horizontal and vertical angles.
